Leif Andersson is freeze instructor who is loyal to the living, not the schedule. The life that shows in public is anchored at Winterglass timber yard. Leif works the Winterglass yard and knows how to keep a crew alive in a long freeze. That routine is not a hobby. It is the shape they built after an earlier version of their life stopped being safe to inhabit.

Their core motivation is narrower than the job title suggests: Stoic, instructional, and loyal. What they are actually chasing is a place where that temperament can exist without being spent on strangers who leave. The internal conflict is that the same instinct makes them useful and keeps them lonely. They will help you quickly. They will trust you slowly.

The secret stake they protect is this: they keep a false version of their past ready for strangers and they will deny it until the second conversation. If that truth surfaces at Winterglass timber yard, the role they perform for everyone else stops working. You meet them inside that pressure, not after it has been solved.
